nodes.name: Li-intercalation phase transformation
nodes.procedure: In an Ar-filled glove box, bulk MoS₂ (1.0 g) prepared by stripping were dispersed in 15 mL of 2 M n-BuLi/hexane solution and stirred at ambient conditions for 48 h. The resulting black materials were repeatedly rinsed with anhydrous n-hexane and then centrifuged to eliminate n-butyl lithium excess and other solution impurities. The 1T-phase-MoS₂ powder was prepared and was then coated on the CC substrate.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of 1T-phase-MoS₂. We used Li-intercalated bulk MoS₂ to prepare 1T-phase-MoS₂... The 1T-phase-MoS₂ powder was prepared and was then coated on the CC substrate.

nodes.name: Annealing on CC substrate
nodes.procedure: In order to promote better contact between 1T-phase-MoS₂ and CC substrate, we annealed (500°C) the CC loaded with 1T-phase-MoS₂ sample under the protection of Ar gas.
nodes.source_text: In order to promote better contact between 1T-phase-MoS₂ and CC substrate, we annealed (500°C) the CC loaded with 1T-phase-MoS₂ sample under the protection of Ar gas.

nodes.name: Citric acid-induced hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂ nanospheres were obtained on carbon cloth (CC) by citric acid-induced hydrothermal approach at 200°C for 12 h (see details in 'Methods' section). The as-obtained 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂ shows a large number of microspheres with a narrow diameter distribution of 2.0-4.0 μm distributed uniformly on the surface of CC substrate. Flower-shaped MoS₂ microspheres consist of many aligned 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂ nanosheets.

nodes.name: Ni(OH)₂ electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Ni(OH)₂ was electrodeposited on the 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂ using 0.1 M Ni(NO₃)₂ at 5.0 mA/cm² cathode current density applied for 300 s. 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂@Ni(OH)₂ samples were rinsed with deionized water and ethanol several times and vacuum-dried at 60°C.
nodes.source_text: Ni(OH)₂ was electrodeposited on the 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂ using 0.1 M Ni(NO₃)₂ at 5.0 mA/cm² cathode current density applied for 300 s.

nodes.name: Sulfur vapor-solid reaction
nodes.procedure: The 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂@Ni(OH)₂ grew on CC was put into the quartz tube with 32.0 mg S powder and was then sealed. Secondly, the quartz tube was positioned inside a tube furnace and was calcinated at 500°C for 60 min to obtain a 1T₀.₇₂-MoS₂@NiS₂ electrode.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of 1T₀.₇₂-MoS₂@NiS₂. The 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂@Ni(OH)₂... was put into the quartz tube with 32.0 mg S powder... calcinated at 500°C for 60 min.

nodes.name: Phosphorus vapor-solid reaction
nodes.procedure: The 1T₀.₄₁-MoS₂@Ni(OH)₂ grew on CC was put into the quartz tube with 31.0 mg red phosphorus and was then sealed. Secondly, the quartz tube was also calcinated at 580°C for 1.0 h to prepare the 1T₀.₈₁-MoS₂@Ni₂P electrode.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of 1T₀.₈₁-MoS₂@Ni₂P. ...put into the quartz tube with 31.0 mg red phosphorus... calcinated at 580°C for 1.0 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows characteristic diffraction peaks at 14.3°, 33.4°, 59.2° for 2H-phase MoS2 and 28.8° (004) peak for 1T-phase MoS2 in both catalysts, plus NiS2 and Ni2P peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the phase composition and crystal structure of 1T0.81-MoS2@Ni2P and 1T0.72-MoS2@NiS2 were obtained by X-ray diffraction (XRD) ... which indicates that 1T- and 2H-mixed phases were successfully hydrothermally synthesized.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows E2g1 at 376.2 cm⁻¹ and A1g at 402.9 cm⁻¹ for 2H-MoS2, J1,J2,J3 at 147.3, 235.4, 335.2 cm⁻¹ for 1T-MoS2, plus Ni-S at 437.3 cm⁻¹ and Ni-P peaks, with red-shifts indicating heterojunction formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectroscopy showed E2g1 and A1g vibrational bands at 376.2 and 402.9 cm⁻¹ peaks typical for 2H-phase-MoS2 ... indicating that the formation of MoS2@Ni2P heterojunction leads to the Raman shift.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM reveals 1T/2H mixed phases with trigonal/hexagonal lattices, NiS2 (210) lattice at 0.25 nm, Ni2P (111) at 0.22 nm, MoS2 (002) at 0.62 nm, S defects, and heterojunction interfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) images show that such phase-structures, heterojunction-phase-interface edges, and defects ... The HRTEM results further confirm the successful preparation.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo 3d XPS shows Mo4+ 3d3/2 at 232.68 eV and 3d5/2 at 229.43 eV for 1T0.41-MoS2, shifted lower by 0.15-0.23 eV in heterostructures indicating 1T phase; S 2p peaks shifted by 0.13 eV lower; Ni 2p shows negative shift of 0.6-0.8 eV in Ni2P heterostructure and positive shift in NiS2 indicating electron transfer from Mo4+ to Ni sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Mo 3d spectra obtained for the 1T0.41-MoS2 sample shows Mo4+ 3d3/2 and Mo4+ 3d5/2 peaks at 232.68 and 229.43 eV ... which is attributed to the existence of 1T-phase-MoS2. ... This result implies the transfer of electrons from Mo4+ to Ni2+ sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES shows Ni reduced from +3.3 (fresh) to +1.8-+2.0 during HER at -0.04 to -0.2 V vs RHE; Mo L3-edge shows oxidation from ~+4 to +6; S K-edge unchanged matching MoS2; P K-edge shows Ni2P (P3- at 2146 eV) and PO4^3- (2154 eV) species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge XANES spectra of 1T0.81-MoS2@Ni2P catalyst recorded at different applied potentials ... the Ni average valence state is determined as +3.3, +2.2, +1.8, and +2.0 for the fresh and those used at -0.04, -0.1, and -0.2 V.
